marks.gloss_en: דאמר מר: התורה אמרה יבא איסור נבלה יחול על איסור חלב, ויבא איסור טרפה יחול על איסור חלב
one master holds it comes and takes effect, just as with fat
ורמינהו: a limb from a living tereifa -- R' Yochanan two, Reish Lakish one; בשלמא לרבי יוחנן ניחא, אלא לרבי שמעון בן לקיש קשיא
לא קשיא: כאן בבהמה אחת, כאן בשתי בהמות (= p_ry_shtei_behemot, p_ry_behema_achat_pligi)
Rav Yosef: here of one animal, there of two animals; with two animals he is liable twice
one who ate a limb from a living tereifa -- R' Yochanan: liable twice
Abaye: e.g., where it became tereifa as the greater part of it emerged
or say: all agree a living animal does not stand into limbs, and they dispute whether the limb ban comes and takes effect on the tereifa ban
or say: all agree a living animal stands into limbs, and it is where it became tereifa afterwards
Rava: e.g., where he tore a limb from it and made it tereifa by it
one who ate forbidden fat from a living tereifa -- liable twice
in what do they dispute? e.g., where it became tereifa as the greater part emerged
the one who says two holds a living animal does not stand into limbs: the fat ban and the tereifa ban are there, the limb ban does not come and take effect
or say: all agree a living animal does not stand into limbs, and they dispute whether the limb ban comes and takes effect on the fat ban and the tereifa ban
or say: all agree a living animal stands into limbs, it became tereifa afterwards, and they dispute whether the tereifa ban comes and takes effect on the limb ban
and the other: for fat he is liable, since it was permitted from its general class; but a limb, which was not permitted from its general class -- no
